"I have a question that grew tired," Leo said softly as I lifted my foot to ask it. "It keeps asking about what we do and why, yet I feel like I'm just repeating the same answer again and again."

I paused, letting the weight of the chair press against my back. My hand hovered over the heavy wood, feeling the texture of age and history pressing down on me.

"I wonder if there is a question that never grows tired," I whispered, looking up at the low-hanging shadows cast by our sanctuary. "Or perhaps it's just asking to be understood without being told."
